Pipeline Filtration for Oil and Gas | Santosh Magnetic Works
For The Oil & Gas Industry

Black powder is fine iron sulphide and iron oxide formed by corrosion inside steel pipelines. It narrows the pipe, wears compressors, pumps and valves, blocks meters and fouls barrier filters that then need replacing and disposing of as hazardous waste.
Because black powder is an iron compound, a magnet holds it. A magnetic pipeline filter takes it out of the flow at full pressure with no consumable element. The rods are lifted out and cleaned.

We make two units. The inline filter is the simpler one for smaller lines. The modular filter is the high pressure unit for transmission and process pipelines. Both are full stainless steel and made to your connection type.
Pipeline range
Where it goes in the system

Upstream, at wellhead control, heating and cooling systems and pressure reduction, to protect valves, meters and compressors. Midstream, in filtration trains, gas gathering stations and at pig receiving stations. Downstream, at refinery inlets and storage.
Tell us the line size, pressure, flow and the contamination you see, and we will size the unit.

Overview - Inline Magnetic Pipeline Filter
Protection for smaller lines

The inline filter is the smaller of our two pipeline filters. Fluid or gas passes the neodymium rods twice on its way through, so nearly all the black powder is held on the first pass. The rods are lifted out for cleaning.

The design does not restrict the flow as it loads, so pressure stays steady between cleans. Full stainless steel construction gives a long life in harsh service. Made to order to your connection and flow rate.
Stainless steel magnetic filter that removes black powder from oil and gas lines. Non-blocking design, made to any connection type or size.

Overview - Modular High Pressure Pipeline Filter
Built for the transmission line

This unit is a modular magnetic filter for oil, gas, petrochemical and fuel pipelines. Ferrous contamination holds to the neodymium cores as the flow passes. Barrier filters downstream stop blocking, and abrasive wear on compressors, pumps, valves and meters falls.
Units are assembled in modules to suit the flow rate. Quick release fittings let the cores be lifted out and cleaned. The stainless steel body is built for a long service life.
We can sample the pipeline and analyse the contamination, size the unit for your flow and connections, and advise on installation, lifting gear for cleaning, and operator training.

Overview - Circular Premier Chuck
Even hold on round work
Round and ring shaped parts can distort if they are gripped at points. A circular chuck holds the whole underside evenly, so thin rings keep their shape while they are ground or turned.

Grooved rings in the top plate help the operator centre the part quickly. Turn the T-key for a light hold, set the part, then turn to full hold. Used on rotary grinders, lathes and inspection tables. Made up to 600 mm diameter.

Magnetic Chucks and Workholding | Santosh Magnetic Works
Hold the work with one lever

A magnetic chuck holds a steel workpiece flat on the machine table. Turn the lever and the part is locked down. There are no clamps in the way of the wheel, so the whole surface is ground in one pass and five faces stay open.

We make rectangular chucks for surface grinders and circular chucks for rotary grinders and lathes, with N35 neodymium magnets and a thick top plate that can be reground many times. Electromagnetic and multicoil chucks are built to customer sizes. The Maxx-Demag bench unit removes the magnetism left in a part after grinding.
Workholding range
Radial pole chuck for rotary grinding and turning, up to 600 mm
What a magnetic chuck gives you

Setting up takes seconds. The hold is the same across the whole plate, with no operator variation and no distortion from clamp pressure. The part cannot vibrate or move, so the finish is better and the wheel lasts longer.

A permanent chuck needs no power and cannot lose its hold in a power cut. Choose a fine pole pitch for small and thin parts, and a standard pitch for large parts. See our guide on {1}choosing a magnetic chuck{/1}
